q1_issues.issue: The "to Oct. 17" endpoint of the extension is asserted as the deadline entity's own Time (with statement 13) instead of being attached to the extend event, so the change of value the sentence states is not recorded as a relation of that event, and Time is put on a non-eventive entity.

q2_gaps: change-of-value verb with a "to <new time>" argument ("extended the deadline to Oct. 17") — no licensed slot for the new value: Goal is the spatial "to", and Time on the extend event would say when the extending happened

a definite "the deadline" bridged to an earlier "by <time>" adjunct in the same sentence — bridging only licenses PartOf, so nothing links the deadline entity to the TimeAtMost that adjunct put on the completion event, leaving two disconnected records of one deadline
notes: The rest follows the instruction set: past perfect plus "then" gives (Before pledge extend), "by August" gives TimeAtMost, "pledged to complete" is the control pattern with the controller copied in and no tense on the complement, the deadline as an altered occurrence takes Patient, and "still working on it" gives On + Ongoing + Still.
